cases.question: Across all vehicles delivered, including those with no claims, which model year and powertrain combination has the highest total warranty cost divided by the number of vehicles delivered in that combination, and what is that figure?
cases.answer: The model year 2023 with BEV powertrain has the highest total warranty cost divided by the number of vehicles delivered in that combination, which is approximately 8289.45 EUR per vehicle.

trace.purpose: Find the model year and powertrain combination with the highest warranty cost per vehicle delivered.
trace.sql:
SELECT
  v.model_year,
  v.powertrain,
  COALESCE(SUM(wc.cost_eur), 0) AS total_warranty_cost,
  COUNT(DISTINCT v.vin) AS vehicle_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(wc.cost_eur), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT v.vin) AS cost_per_vehicle
FROM gishub.fleet.vehicles v
LEFT JOIN gishub.fleet.warranty_claims wc
  ON v.vin = wc.vin
GROUP BY v.model_year, v.powertrain
ORDER BY cost_per_vehicle DESC
LIMIT 1

cases.question: Considerando todos los vehículos entregados, incluidos los que no tienen ninguna reclamación, ¿qué combinación de año de modelo y tren motriz tiene el mayor coste total de garantía dividido entre el número de vehículos entregados de esa combinación, y cuál es esa cifra?
cases.answer: La combinación de año de modelo y tren motriz con el mayor coste total de garantía dividido entre el número de vehículos entregados es 2023 y BEV, con una cifra de 8,289.45 euros por vehículo.

trace.purpose: Find the combination of model year and powertrain with the highest average warranty cost per delivered vehicle.
trace.sql:
SELECT v.model_year, v.powertrain, SUM(COALESCE(wc.cost_eur, 0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT v.vin) AS avg_warranty_cost_per_vehicle
FROM gishub.fleet.vehicles v
LEFT JOIN gishub.fleet.warranty_claims wc ON v.vin = wc.vin
GROUP BY v.model_year, v.powertrain
ORDER BY avg_warranty_cost_per_vehicle DESC
LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many high-voltage battery warranty claims were opened on model year 2023 BEV vehicles?
cases.answer: There were 462 high-voltage battery warranty claims opened on model year 2023 BEV vehicles. This is based on counting the relevant warranty claims linked to 2023 BEV vehicles with component 'battery_hv'.

trace.purpose: Count high-voltage battery warranty claims on 2023 BEV vehicles
trace.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wc.claim_id) AS high_voltage_battery_claims_2023_bev
FROM gishub.fleet.warranty_claims wc
JOIN gishub.fleet.vehicles v ON wc.vin = v.vin
WHERE wc.component = 'battery_hv'
AND v.powertrain = 'BEV'
AND v.model_year = 2023;

cases.answer: Se abrieron 462 reclamaciones de garantía de batería de alta tensión en vehículos BEV del año 2023.

trace.purpose: Contar reclamaciones de garantía de batería de alta tensión para BEV del año 2023

FROM gishub.fleet.warranty_claims AS wc

cases.question: What share of total charging energy was delivered at public DC chargers, as a percentage?
cases.answer: The share of total charging energy delivered at public DC chargers is (2413117.6 / 7933747.87) * 100 ≈ 30.4%. This is based on the sum of energy delivered at public DC chargers divided by the total energy delivered in all charging sessions.

trace.purpose: Calculate share of total charging energy delivered at public DC chargers
trace.sql:
SELECT  
  SUM(CASE WHEN location_type = 'public_dc' THEN energy_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS energy_public_dc_kwh,
  SUM(energy_kwh) AS energy_total_kwh
FROM gishub.fleet.charging_sessions

cases.question: ¿Qué porcentaje de la energía total de carga se entregó en cargadores públicos de DC?
cases.answer: El 30.42% de la energía total de carga se entregó en cargadores públicos de DC, calculado como la fracción de la energía en esos cargadores respecto a la energía total cargada.

trace.purpose: Calcular el porcentaje de energía entregada en cargadores públicos de DC sobre la energía total de carga
trace.sql:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN location_type = 'public_dc' THEN energy_kwh ELSE 0 END) / SUM(energy_kwh) AS pct_energy_public_dc
FROM gishub.fleet.charging_sessions

cases.question: Which customer segment accounts for the most warranty cost?
cases.answer: The municipal customer segment accounts for the most warranty cost, totaling 1,254,498.41 euros. This is based on aggregating warranty costs by customer segment.

trace.purpose: Determine which customer segment has the highest total warranty cost
trace.sql: SELECT c.segment, SUM(w.cost_eur) AS total_warranty_cost FROM gishub.fleet.warranty_claims w LEFT JOIN gishub.fleet.vehicles v ON w.vin = v.vin LEFT JOIN gishub.fleet.fleet_customers c ON v.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY total_warranty_cost DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: ¿Qué segmento de cliente acumula más coste de garantía?
cases.answer: El segmento de cliente que acumula más coste de garantía es el segmento "municipal" con un coste total acumulado de aproximadamente 1,254,498.41 euros. Esto se debe a que, al sumar los costes de todas las reclamaciones de garantía por segmento, el segmento municipal tiene el valor más alto.

trace.purpose: Determinar el segmento de cliente con mayor coste acumulado en garantía
trace.sql:
SELECT fc.segment, SUM(wc.cost_eur) AS total_warranty_cost
FROM gishub.fleet.warranty_claims wc
JOIN gishub.fleet.vehicles v ON wc.vin = v.vin
JOIN gishub.fleet.fleet_customers fc ON v.customer_id = fc.customer_id
GROUP BY fc.segment
ORDER BY total_warranty_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

cases.question: What percentage of fault events resulted in a warranty claim?
cases.answer: 27.92% of fault events resulted in a warranty claim. This figure comes from dividing the number of fault events linked to warranty claims by the total number of fault events.

trace.purpose: Calculate the percentage of fault events that have a corresponding warranty claim by comparing distinct fault event IDs with those linked in warranty claims.
trace.sql:
SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT w.event_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.event_id), 0) AS pct_faults_with_warranty_claim
FROM gishub.fleet.fault_events f
LEFT JOIN gishub.fleet.warranty_claims w ON f.event_id = w.event_id

cases.question: ¿Qué porcentaje de eventos de fallo derivó en una reclamación de garantía?
cases.answer:
El 27.91% de los eventos de fallo derivó en una reclamación de garantía.  
(Este porcentaje se calcula como 1210 eventos con reclamación sobre 4334 eventos totales de fallo.)

trace.purpose: Calcular el porcentaje de eventos de fallo que derivaron en una reclamación de garantía
trace.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT fe.event_id) AS total_fault_events,
  COUNT(DISTINCT wc.event_id) AS fault_events_with_claim
FROM gishub.fleet.fault_events fe
LEFT JOIN gishub.fleet.warranty_claims wc ON fe.event_id = wc.event_id
